notes.title: Update notes for 01/04 - 1.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed checkpoint resuming updates in 1.0.2 to work correctly for hubs 2, 3, and 4
[*] Fixed incorrect hub and level numbers when prompted to clear existing checkpoint data
[/list]

Thanks to SPAMtm for the bug catches

notes.title: Update notes for 30/03 - 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Checkpoint data will now persist when you exit a level. You can return to a level to pick up from where you left off. The checkpoint data will be cleared if you start another level.
[/list]

Thanks to SPAMtm for the suggestion!

notes.title: Updates notes for 27/03 - 1.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed checkpoint in hub 1 level 4 dumping you into the abyss
[*] Fixed controller trigger navigation of hub and level selects from allowing you to access levels that have not been unlocked yet
[/list]

Shout out to crimsonmajor for the bug reports

notes.title: 1.0.0 demo now available
notes.content: Preparations are underway for the 1.0.0 game release. All the exciting updates that are going into the final game have made their way into the demo. Check it out now to get a taste of what you can experience in the full game.

notes.title: Playtesting - Chapter 2
notes.content:
Playtesting for the second chapter of Buck's adventures is now available. For any feedback please join us on the Mango Moose Discord [url=https://discord.gg/asXrdh53AK][/url].

Playtest levels 1 through 10 across 2 chapters.

notes.title: Playtesting - Chapter 1
notes.content:
Playtesting for the first chapter of Buck's adventures is now available. For any feedback please join us on the Mango Moose Discord [url=https://discord.gg/asXrdh53AK][/url].

Levels 2 - 5 are currently missing sound and story elements, for this playtest we are focusing on players being able to navigate and complete the available levels.
